title: Let's discover phenomena instead of solving problems
snippet: Remember the Mandelbrot set? The Mandelbrot set is the set of complex numbers c such that if we define x_1 = 0 and x_{n + 1} = x_n^2 + c, then |x_n| doesn't go to infinity. It's a simple definition, but when you plot it, you get mind-blowing fractal images like the ones in the animation above. What an amazing phenomenon! I bring it up because mathematical disciplines are currently going through a kind of existential crisis.
